data.name: WelcomeDescription
data.value: Take one minute to learn the core interface and quickly find devices, solutions, and your workspace.

data.name: MenuStepDescription
data.value: Access files, templates, tools, views, and other features from the top menu. The highlighted area remains interactive.

data.name: ExplorerStepDescription
data.value: Switch the left panel between Device Control and Solution Explorer. Use the first to view and operate devices, and the second to browse projects, flows, and files.

data.name: WorkspaceStepDescription
data.value: Flows, cameras, algorithms, and calibration open as tabs. Switch tabs to enter the corresponding configuration and operation view.

data.name: StatusStepDescription
data.value: The status bar shows the active solution and runtime state, with access to background tasks and data status.

data.name: CompletionDescription
data.value: You now know the main ColorVision interface. Open Help → Product tour whenever you need this introduction again.
